LESSON: READING 8.2.1 INTENSIVE READING – LEGENDS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you read intensively?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. respond to questions from legends for comprehension

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 8.2.1 INTENSIVE READING – LEGENDS
This lesson teaches Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends for Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. respond to questions from legends for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends above.
2. Explain Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading – Legends important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you read intensively?
2. Why can an individual be considered a legend in the society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. respond to questions from legends for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
